#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    std::string s_new = s.substr(0,1) + s.substr(1).replace(0, 2, s.substr(1).find("at") == 0 ? "@" : s.substr(1).replace(0, 2, "at")); // This line needs correction
    // Correct approach:
    // First, replace only the first occurrence of "at" after the first character
    size_t pos = s.find("at", 1);
    if (pos != std::string::npos) {
        s_new = s[0] + s.substr(1, pos - 1) + "@" + s.substr(pos + 2);
    } else {
        s_new = s;
    }
    // Now, replace "dot" in the middle part
    std::string result = s_new[0] + s_new.substr(1, s_new.size() - 2);
    size_t dot_pos = result.find("dot");
    if (dot_pos != std::string::npos) {
        result.replace(dot_pos, 3, ".");
    }
    // Append the last character
    result += s_new.back();
    std::cout << result << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
